## Learning goals

- I can describe colour using hue, saturation, and value.
- I can explain the difference between RGB screens and CMYK printing.
- I can explain how opacity changes the result.

::: {.callout-note}
The lesson keeps the strongest diagrams from the [Graphics Accommodation Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AfDpLSJQtKy7YUMdwL8-BBR81NTv9Ck_cyzQ4pA2Hk4/edit) and trims repeated examples so the visual sequence is easier to follow.
:::
